| Statistic | Value (km) | Value (mi) |

2. **Standard Deviation** – Using the built‑in `standard_deviation` function on the list `[750, 320, 450, 290]` returned **181.99 km**.  
   - Converted to miles: 181.99 km × 0.621371 mi/km ≈ **113.08 mi**.
